title: Context left is not updated after running /compact command
body:
### What version of Codex is running?

codex-cli 0.20.0

### Which model were you using?

gpt-5-high reasoning

### What platform is your computer?

MacOS

### What steps can reproduce the bug?

The /compact command doesn't work - no errors whatsoever, but it does nothing. 

It gets into 'working..' state then just returns to chat state. Nothing happens.

### What is the expected behavior?

To have the AI compact the conversation, no?

### What do you see instead?

_No response_

### Additional information

_No response_

linked_prs.title: show messages if there is no delta. i.e. /Compact command feedback

ai_judgment.response: Yes, this is an agent issue. The problem involves an agent workflow anomaly where the /compact command fails to execute as expected, resulting in a hanging state and no changes to the conversation context, indicating an issue with agent orchestration.
